component.name: Superwhisper
component.summary: Fast local and cloud dictation (unofficial Flatpak)

description.p: Superwhisper turns speech into text with local (Vulkan) or cloud transcription and pastes it into the focused application. Built for Wayland: KDE Plasma, GNOME and Hyprland.
Unofficial Flatpak. The Superwhisper release archive is downloaded from superwhisper.com at install time and is not redistributed. Not affiliated with or supported by Superwhisper.
